text: Program Description This subject is a new subject in which advanced molecular biology techniques such as DNA recombination, molecular cloning and biochemistry are used to study biochemical drugs and biological products. It was developed on the basis of pharmacy, pharmaceutical engineering, bioengineering and biotechnology. The subject involves two aspects: one is the microbial medicine, main research produced by microbial metabolism related questions of all kinds of drugs, including breeding, metabolic regulation, isolation, purification, physiological active substances of screening, such as antibiotics,; Second, biochemistry, the main research of the composition and metabolism of the organism to produce drug related issues, including the extraction and separation of the drug, the curative effect of drugs, structure-activity relationship studies of drugs and biological drugs (antibodies, peptides, growth factors and enzyme, etc.) production and preparation process of research. Duration 3 years
